# ProjectBase — Full Autonomous Agent Specification & Operating Manual

## 1. System Overview
ProjectBase is the central project management, Kanban, and sprint execution engine on Homelab.
It provides zero-latency SQLite database backing, instant REST APIs, real-time Server-Sent Events (SSE), and direct FastMCP integration for AI agents (Cursor, Flomaster, Hermes, Claude, and Windmill).

## 2. Server Architecture
- Base URL: ${PROJECTBASE_URL:-http://localhost:8120}
- PocketBase Admin UI: ${PROJECTBASE_URL:-http://localhost:8120}/_/ (set via ADMIN_EMAIL and ADMIN_PASSWORD)
- OpenAPI Specification: ${PROJECTBASE_URL:-http://localhost:8120}/openapi.json
- Interactive Scalar Docs: ${PROJECTBASE_URL:-http://localhost:8120}/docs/
- FastMCP Script: /data/projects/projectbase/scripts/mcp_server.py

## 3. Autonomous Agent Operating Loop
When an agent is assigned to work on a project:
1. **Discover Tasks**: Call 'list_issues(project="KEY", status="todo")' or GET /api/collections/issues/records?filter=(project='<PID>' && status='todo').
2. **Claim Task**: Update status to 'in_progress' (update_issue(identifier="KEY-1", status="in_progress")).
3. **Execute Implementation**: Implement code in repository, execute unit tests, run verification.
4. **Log Progress Comments**: Post intermediate observations via 'add_comment(identifier="KEY-1", content="Verified step 1")'.
5. **Mark Done**: Update status to 'done' (update_issue(identifier="KEY-1", status="done")). This fires real-time SSE updates to all open web boards.

## 4. Collections Schema
### projects
- id (15 char text)
- name (text, required)
- identifier (text, uppercase 2-6 chars, e.g. LOAD, IBR, PB, HOME, OMNI, MEM)
- description (text)
- icon (emoji text)
- color (hex color)
- repo_url (text)
- is_favorite (bool)

### issues
- id (15 char text)
- project (relation -> projects, required)
- identifier (text, e.g. LOAD-1, auto-generated by hook)
- issue_number (number, auto-incremented per project)
- title (text, required)
- description (text, markdown)
- status (enum: backlog | todo | in_progress | in_review | done | cancelled)
- priority (enum: urgent | high | medium | low | none)
- estimate (number, story points)
- assignee (text)
- due_date (date)
- cycle (relation -> cycles)
- subtasks (json array of {id, title, done})
- labels (json array of string tags)
- order (number timestamp for drag-and-drop sort)

### cycles (sprints)
- id (15 char text)
- project (relation -> projects, required)
- name (text, e.g. "Sprint 1 - Launch")
- description (text)
- start_date (date)
- end_date (date)
- status (enum: upcoming | active | completed)

### comments
- id (15 char text)
- issue (relation -> issues, required)
- author (text, e.g. "Flomaster Agent", "Andrian")
- author_type (enum: user | agent | system)
- content (text, markdown)

## 5. cURL Snippets for Non-MCP Agents
### Create Task:
curl -s -X POST ${PROJECTBASE_URL:-http://localhost:8120}/api/projectbase/quick-task \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"project_key":"LOAD","title":"Add GPS tracker webhook","priority":"high","status":"todo","estimate":3}'

### Transition Status:
curl -s -X PATCH ${PROJECTBASE_URL:-http://localhost:8120}/api/collections/issues/records/<ISSUE_ID> \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"status":"done"}'

### Append Execution Log:
curl -s -X POST ${PROJECTBASE_URL:-http://localhost:8120}/api/collections/comments/records \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"issue":"<ISSUE_ID>","author":"Flomaster Agent","author_type":"agent","content":"E2E browser QA passed with zero errors."}'
